title: File:Raia da Atalaia Fernando de Noronha 05.jpg

ObjectName.value: Raia da Atalaia Fernando de Noronha 05

Categories.value: Fernando de Noronha|Taken with Olympus E-500|Pernambuco|World Heritage Sites in Brazil|Files from external sources with reviewed licenses|Files from Flickr with changed licenses|Featured pictures of landscapes|Featured pictures of the Atlantic Ocean|Featured pictures from Flickr|Featured pictures of Fernando de Noronha

ImageDescription.value:
Praia da Atalaia, Fernando de Noronha. The natural pool with the people on the right is one of the island's main touristic attractions.

Fernando de Noronha is an archipelago in the Atlantic Ocean, midway from South America to Africa, around 220 miles (354 km) away from the Brazilian coast. It is a special municipality (distrito estatal) of the Brazilian state of Pernambuco. (en:Fernando de Noronha)
